description_en: Queries the information about URL-based upload jobs
description_zh: 调用GetURLUploadInfos获取URL上传信息，适用于通过URL上传文件的场景，用于查询上传任务的详细信息
name: GetUrlUploadInfos

parameters.description_en:
The IDs of the upload jobs. You can specify one or more job IDs. You can obtain the job IDs from the response parameter JobId of the [UploadMediaByURL](~~86311~~) operation.

- You can specify a maximum of 10 job IDs.

- Separate the job IDs with commas (,).

> You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If you specify both parameters, only the value of JobIds takes effect.
parameters.description_zh:
上传任务ID（JobId）列表。由一个或多个JobId组成，JobId为通过[UploadMediaByURL](~~86311~~)接口上传时，返回参数JobId的值。
- 最多支持10个ID。
- 多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds。
parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the upload jobs. You can specify one or more job IDs. You can obtain the job IDs from the response parameter JobId of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86311.html operation.

parameters.name: job_ids

parameters.description_en:
The upload URLs of the source files. You can specify a maximum of 10 URLs. Separate the URLs with commas (,).

>

- The URLs must be encoded.

- If a media file is uploaded multiple times, we recommend that you specify the URL of the media file only once in this parameter.

- You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If you specify both parameters, only the value of JobIds takes effect.
parameters.description_zh:
上传视频源文件URL列表。多个URL之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持10个。
> - 使用前，先进行URL编码。
> - 如果同一URL视频多次上传，建议传入单个URL进行查询。
> - JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds。
